snippet.title: WHEEL WORLD | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
explore, race, upgrade, and save the world along the way

Wheel World is out now on PC, PS5 & Xbox Series X|S

Grab your copy:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1497460/Wheel_World/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/wheel-world-1668c7
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012810
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/wheel-world/9NGCFDHR2MV3/0010

-

Welcome to Wheel World,  a cosmic biking adventure where the fate of the universe rests on your handlebars.

Play as Kat, a young rider on a mission to reclaim legendary bike parts and perform the Great Shift: a ritual that could restore balance to a world on the brink. Explore vast landscapes, from neon highways to scenic forests, meet strange spirits, and take on rival cyclists in high-speed races across a semi-open world.

Tweak and upgrade your ride with various parts to suit your style,  whether you’re building a sleek street racer or a ridable hotdog. With an original soundtrack by Italians Do It Better and a focus on exploration, momentum, and good vibes, Wheel World is a tribute to the joy of riding and finding the road less travelled.

-

Song: Orion "Stardust & Danger"
Written By Orion Rigel Dommisse & Johnny Jewel
Performed By Orion & Johnny Jewel
Produced By Johnny Jewel

-

Developed by Messhof. Published by Annapurna Interactive.

© Annapurna Interactive, 2025
